designationHistory.name: Sanibel National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: At the urging of Jay Norwood "Ding" Darling, the Sanibel National Wildlife Refuge was established through a lease agreement with the State of Florida under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act.

authority.citation: Lease agreement with the State of Florida under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: FWS gives December 1, 1945. The only non-FWS source read is a 2010 reader letter that says 1945; too weak to confirm. A popular site claims President Truman bought the land; no evidence of that was found, and it should not be repeated. Later renamed for Darling; renaming date not verified.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: J.N. "Ding" Darling NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2010)
